description: ACL condition-handler error handling — cross-language SECURITY golden test. A custom condition handler that raises/throws/panics during evaluation MUST fail CLOSED (the rule does not match → the call is denied, never silently allowed) AND the emitted AuditEntry MUST carry a non-null `handler_error`. Locks sync findings A-D-011 (fail-closed) and A-D-012 (handler_error surfaced in audit). Driver contract: before evaluation, register a built-in test condition handler under the key named by `throwing_condition_key` whose evaluate() raises/throws/panics. Build an ACL from `rules` (a rule references that key in its `conditions`) with the given `default_effect`, wire an audit sink, call check(caller_id, target_id). Assert the decision equals `expected` and that the captured AuditEntry's handler_error is non-null when `expected_audit_handler_error_present` is true.
